notes: The text says one outer pin goes to GND and the other outer pin to 5V. The image shows black (GND) on the left outer pin and red (5V) on the right outer pin, so I used that.
Exact breadboard columns and rows are estimated from the image. I put the pot legs in 10b.f, 11b.f and 12b.f, and the wires in row g of the same columns.
The yellow wire appears to end at the pot body in the image. I assumed it plugs into the same column strip as the middle (wiper) pin.
The pot is wired GND (outer), SIG (middle), VCC (outer), as in the schematic.
The USB cable to the computer is not shown in the circuit, so I left it out.
The black wire goes to the GND pin in the power header (GND.1). The red wire goes to 5V and the yellow wire to A0.
